subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should Feishu `feishu_doc` `create` support an optional `content` field, or should OpenClaw explicitly reject `content` for `create` and document the two-step workflow?
rationale: Current main no longer documents `content` on `create`, but the runtime path can still silently drop an unexpected content value; choosing write-on-create versus fail-fast rejection is a user-facing tool contract decision.

options.title: Support create with content
options.body: Add `content` to the create schema, call the existing markdown write path after creation, and return enough partial-failure detail for recovery if the write step fails.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Keep creation title-only, tighten validation or add an explicit runtime error for `content`, and document `create` followed by `write` as the supported workflow.

recommendation.title: Support create with content
recommendation.body: Add `content` to the create schema, call the existing markdown write path after creation, and return enough partial-failure detail for recovery if the write step fails.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned Feishu doc-create security behavior and were already pulled into the create-with-content discussion.
